handoff_instructions: M2-T23 done. Added packages/domain/src/sms-ack-template.ts (SMS_ACK_TEMPLATE_RULE_ACTION + smsAckTemplateDefinitionSchema, a business_rules kind following receptionist-config.ts's precedent: only rule.write, i.e. the owner, can ever create one, so an active rule is owner-approved by construction; there is still no write UI/service for it, same gap as receptionist.config since M2-T19 - a future task, not this one). packages/core/src/services/messaging.ts: loadActiveSmsAckTemplate + new exported acknowledgeInboundSms(ctx, {communicationId, callerNumber, businessNumber}) - sends the org's active template via requestOutboundSms with idempotencyKey `sms.ack:${communicationId}` (stable across redeliveries since communication_id is upserted per provider_conversation_id), or opens a missing_data ops case if no template is active (never guesses text). packages/workflows/src/webhook-processor.ts: handleInboundSms now resolves the caller match once (extracted participantsForMatch from the old callerParticipant, avoiding a second ambiguous-caller ops case) and calls acknowledgeInboundSms for every inbound SMS except a caller matched to a known employee (M3 will route those to field capture). New test packages/workflows/test/sms-acknowledgement.test.ts covers: unknown caller acknowledged + audited, known customer also acknowledged, redelivery sends exactly one ack, known employee gets none, missing template opens an ops case instead of sending. format/lint/typecheck/test all pass (full pnpm test green). Next: M2-T24 "Operations view of stuck webhooks and outbound operations".
